definitions.explanation: A situation that was not predicted or planned for. Used in formal contexts when discussing risk management, emergency preparedness, and crisis response.

examples.japanese: {不測|ふそく}の{事態|じたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧。
{不測|ふそく}の{事態|じたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦{手順|てじゅん}→手順：05452_tejun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: We confirmed the response procedures in case of an emergency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不測|ふそく}の{事態|じたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}して→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{対処|たいしょ}できる→対処する：20049_taishosuru⟧よう、⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}した→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I took out insurance so I can deal with unexpected situations during business trips abroad.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal expression used in risk management, business planning, and official communications. Often appears in safety manuals, disaster preparedness documents, and contracts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不測|ふそく}の{事態|じたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧ (to prepare for contingencies)
- {不測|ふそく}の{事態|じたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧ (an unexpected situation occurs)
- {不測|ふそく}の{事態|じたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ (to fall into an unforeseen situation)
- {不測|ふそく}の{事態|じたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対処|たいしょ}する→対処する：20049_taishosuru⟧ (to deal with an emergency)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{緊急事態|きんきゅうじたい}→緊急事態：16936_kinkyuujitai⟧: emergency — specifically an urgent crisis requiring immediate action
- ⟦{非常事態|ひじょうじたい}→非常事態：17519_hijoujitai⟧: state of emergency — an officially declared crisis
- ⟦{想定外|そうていがい}→想定外：17518_souteigai⟧: beyond expectations — something that was not anticipated, less formal
